messages:
Jess (content): Heads-up — I want to sync on a cross-team plan to launch the new OSS refapp 'benchlab' + a short webinar that shows benchmark narratives, hands-on tutorial, and clear inbound routing. :rocket:
Mike (growth): love it. timeline? thinking 3-week runway for content + 1-week gated webinar signup flow.
Alejandra (devrel): I can do a 20min demo + 10min Q&A for the webinar. also want a 10‑minute hands-on tutorial we can turn into a quick-start.
Sam (design): I can mock the landing hero and 3 social tiles by EOW. need the value props and primary CTA copy.
Jess (content): Primary angles: 1) easy to spin up inference locally 2) real cost/latency bench comparisons vs cloud endpoints 3) migration path to Redwood Dedicated. Short headline options: "Benchlab: real-world inference benchmarks + refapp" or "Run, measure, optimize — a dev guide to inference with Benchlab"
Mike (growth): For inbound routing: gated webinar leads -> HubSpot list "benchlab-webinar"; post-webinar follow-up flows to the OSS product newsletter + demo request CTA for enterprise. We should add UTM params and a simple quiz question on the form to route hot leads (self-serve vs enterprise).
Liam (analytics): Use utm_source=benchlab_launch, utm_campaign=benchlab_q2; capture hidden field: "deployment_interest" with values [hosted,dedicated,private]. I'll add the form mapping to HubSpot.
Alejandra (devrel): Reminder: tutorial should include a minimal Docker example and a single-command run. Suggest we put this snippet on the landing and repo README:
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/benchlab:latest \n# then curl localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize..."}'
```
Sam (design): nice, will design a code block treatment and 2 CTA buttons: "Try locally" (links to GitHub) and "Register webinar" (gated).
Jess (content): Marketing assets needed: launch post (blog), short benchmark story post (linked), webinar page, 3 social posts, repo README updates, email drip + webinar slides. Assigning owners: blog = Jess, benchmark post = Mike + Alejandra, webinar page = Mike, repo README = Alejandra, design = Sam.
Mike (growth): I'll wire the registration page. Question: gated or not for replay? gated for replay but use a simple 1-field form (email) to maximize leads.
Liam (analytics): If replay gated, add a hidden param for original source so we can de-duplicate. Also plan an experiment: 50% gated replay vs 50% open—if we want to test conversion vs reach.
Alejandra (devrel): For the benchmark narrative, want to show token/sec and median-latency percentiles as short tables. I'll produce a CSV export for the blog and a condensed chart for slides.
Jess (content): Messaging iteration: we'll A/B headline and the hero subcopy on the landing. Draft copy by Tue. Need 1-liner for social that highlights: "Open-source reference app for realistic inference benchmarking + deploy patterns"
Sam (design): I'll push hero comps to Figma with the two copy variants.
Mike (growth): Tagging integrations checklist: GA, HubSpot, LinkedIn Pixel, Vero (email). Also set up webinar zap to add registrants to HubSpot + send confirmation email.
webhook-bot: scheduled_webinar: webinar 'Benchlab: measure & optimize inference' scheduled for 2024-07-18 16:00 UTC, registrants=0
Jess (content): Looks good. Next steps: briefs in the shared drive — Jess will drop a content brief + prompt set for benchmark claims; Alejandra will push the README PR and a short demo video; Mike will build the registration page and set up routing. Check-in Friday 11am PT.
Mike (growth): I'll create the HubSpot list and share access.
Liam (analytics): I'll prep the tracking doc and event map and share before Friday.
Alejandra (devrel): I'll draft the tutorial repo skeleton today and ping for review.
Sam (design): Will upload initial hero variants by tomorrow noon.
Jess (content): Final ask — keep social copy short + lead with an actionable metric (e.g., "Benchlab shows 3x lower tail latency with KV cache") so we have strong hook.
Mike (growth): noted. I'll add metric hooks to the webinar description and promote via our dev channels.
Jess (content): Thanks everyone — will update the brief and tag assignees. :thumbsup:
